credits.title: God Is Still Brazilian
credits.overview: God needs to return to Earth when celestial beings rebel against humanity and decide to launch another meteor to exterminate life on the planet.

credits.title: Paterno
credits.overview: Sérgio is determined to take over his family's construction company to pursue a long-buried dream. But when he uncovers a hidden chapter from his father's past, his ambitions are shaken, forcing him to confront the man he has truly become.

credits.title: The Secret Agent
credits.overview: Brazil, 1977. Marcelo, a technology expert in his early 40s, is on the run. Hoping to reunite with his son, he travels to Recife during Carnival but soon realizes that the city is not the safe haven he was expecting.

credits.title: Jorge Quer Ser Repórter
credits.overview: Among the hardships that Jorge experiences with his best friend, in the countryside of Paraíba, it is right in the middle of the world that he will get closer to his dream of being a reporter.
